vocabulary.meaning_en: an ending that makes an adverb: -ly, -ward(s), -wise
vocabulary.example: "-ly" is the most common adverb suffix.
He is an exceptionally bright student.

vocabulary.note_ar: towards أكثر في بريطانيا و toward في أمريكا

vocabulary.meaning_en: to the front / to the back
towards the inside / towards the outside

vocabulary.example: He walked sideways towards the camera.

vocabulary.meaning_en: about time; in relation to time
vocabulary.example: Time-wise, this video is about fifteen minutes long.
Money-wise, we are doing well this year.
Hurry up, otherwise you'll miss the bus.
Questions pertaining to money go to the office.

fine_lines.title: -ward(s) vs -wise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: -ward(s) تدل على الاتجاه (forward, homeward). -wise تعني "من حيث / فيما يتعلق بـ" وتُضاف إلى اسم (time-wise, money-wise). ولا علاقة لها هنا بمعنى wise = حكيم.
fine_lines.explanation_en: -ward(s) shows direction (forward, homeward). -wise means "about / in relation to" and is added to a noun (time-wise, money-wise). It has nothing to do with wise = clever here.

examples.sentence: We drove homeward after the trip.

fine_lines.title: toward vs forward
fine_lines.explanation_ar: towards = باتجاه مكان ما، بأي طريقة (للأمام أو للخلف أو جانبيًا). forward = إلى الأمام فقط.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Towards" = in the direction of a place, in any way (front, back or sideways). "Forward" = to the front only.

examples.sentence: He walked backwards towards the door.

expressions.meaning_ar: من حيث الوقت، أوشكنا على الانتهاء.
expressions.example: Time-wise, we're almost finished. Just one more question.
After a long trip, we're homeward bound.

grammar.title: What a suffix does
grammar.explanation_ar: اللاحقة تُضاف بعد الكلمة، وقد تغيّر نوع الكلمة أو معناها أو كليهما: work (فعل) + er → worker (اسم، شخص يعمل).
grammar.explanation_en: A suffix is added after a word. It can change the word class, the meaning, or both: work (verb) + -er → worker (noun, a person who works).

grammar.title: -ly: the most common adverb ending
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف ly إلى صفة لنصنع ظرفًا يصف كيف يحدث الفعل: quick → quickly, beautiful → beautifully. يأتي الظرف عادة بعد الفعل. انتبه: بعض الصفات تنتهي بـ ly (friendly).
grammar.explanation_en: Add -ly to an adjective to make an adverb that describes how an action happens: quick → quickly, beautiful → beautifully. The adverb usually comes after the verb. Careful: some adjectives end in -ly (friendly).
examples: The man ran quickly up the hill.
She dressed beautifully for the occasion.

grammar.title: -ward(s): direction
grammar.explanation_ar: ward أو wards تعني الاتجاه، وهي قليلة (حوالي عشر كلمات): forward, backward, upward, downward, inward, outward, toward, homeward, onward.
grammar.explanation_en: -ward or -wards means direction. There are only about ten: forward, backward, upward, downward, inward, outward, toward, homeward, onward.
examples: He walked backward towards the camera.

grammar.title: -wise: relating to (noun + -wise)
grammar.explanation_ar: نضيف wise إلى اسم بمعنى "فيما يتعلق بـ": time-wise, money-wise, budget-wise, family-wise. ونجد أيضًا otherwise = وإلا.
grammar.explanation_en: Add -wise to a noun to mean "relating to": time-wise, money-wise, budget-wise, family-wise. Also: otherwise = if not.
examples: Leave now, otherwise you'll be late.
